topic: Memory Grove tree readability and hover polish
currentUserGoal: Respond to playtest feedback that balance felt better, but the Memory Grove skill screen needs work: no crossing lines, smaller tree icons, zoomed icon on hover/card, and animated hover feedback.
workCompleted: Reworked Memory Grove node positions into a two-lane layout: Soft Touch branches to Deeper Roots and Tiny Sprinkler; the top lane leads to Scourge Sense; the bottom/right lane leads to Last Stand.
Changed Last Stand's visual connection from Deeper Roots + Tiny Sprinkler to Scourge Sense + Tiny Sprinkler so connector lines no longer cross through the tree.
Reduced overview icon scale inside each skill node while keeping node frames readable.
Simplified overview node labels to name plus one short state line, moving richer description/effect information into the side detail card.
Added a large zoomed skill icon to the Memory Grove detail card that updates on hover/selection.
Added animation for the selected tree icon and the zoomed detail-card icon: pulse, tiny bob, and subtle angle motion.
Disabled the old floating hover tooltip so it no longer covers nodes or connector lines.
verificationRun: npm run check passed after the Memory Grove polish: ESLint, 30 Vitest tests, TypeScript, and Vite production build.
Earlier browser visual pass after the first tree-layout change confirmed the Memory Grove rendered with the new two-row node layout and zoomed detail icon.
After the final label cleanup, the in-app browser control session timed out while reconnecting, so the final visual pass still needs user/manual confirmation.
